segment.source:
::Stale odor distills from this man, and while it is not a terribly strong one it is enough to make his presence an uncomfortable one. This old, unkempt fellow is wearing clothes that look like they had been stolen from a grave, and are likely to be a great contributor to the unpleasant scent fouling the air around him.::
Hey there, youngster. Name's Tom, Dirty Tom.<end>

segment.source: People call me that because I'm not afraid to get down and dirty when it comes to scavenging rare stuff from remote and... often unsavory places, he-he-he.<end>
segment.target: People call me that because I'm not afraid to get down and dirty when it comes to scavenging rare stuff from remote and... often unsavory places, he-he-he.<end>

segment.source: I'm sure that's the true reason.<end>
segment.target: I'm sure that's the true reason.<end>

segment.source: I'll be setting up shop here with the Zone Rats. If you see anything you like, let me know and we'll make a deal.<end>
segment.target: I'll be setting up shop here with the Zone Rats. If you see anything you like, let me know and we'll make a deal.<end>

segment.source: Let's see what you got, old timer. ::Barter.::<end>
segment.target: Let's see what you got, old timer. ::Barter.::<end>

segment.source: Listen up, youngster, I was scavenging stuff right here in this ol' city before you were even born. I mean, sure, there wasn't much to scavenge before Biocorp got dominated by Underrail Protectorate, but I'd be damned if I wasn't able to dig out some cool stuff even then. You can say I earned a sort of a... reputation among the locals.<end>

segment.source:
So, just recently I heard that the Zone Rats were looking for someone of my caliber, and, well, you know what happened next.
::He leans forward and whispers.:: Oh, do you know what's funny, youngster? In one of the caves close to this - *this* very place I found Rocker's corpse. In case you don't know, he was one of the gladiators who fought several years ago. Damn good he was, but he just... poof, disappeared one day.<end>

segment.source:
He committed suicide by shooting himself five times in the head - and no one knows why to this day. I found him a few months after his death. I... may have taken some coins from his pocket - don't you judge me!
So, ya interested in a trade or not?<end>

segment.source: How do you feel about the Faceless invasion?<end>
segment.target: How do you feel about the Faceless invasion?<end>

segment.source: I was more scared at first, when the fightin' began - I though we were all goners! We're gonna get dominated like rats, I thought to myself! I almost fled the city with Mrs. Dirty. ::He grins.:: But as things currently stand, these Faceless, they are lookin' for something mighty fancy. Think about it: Why haven't they crushed us by now? As terrifying as these spooks are, I think they are here for a specific reason and will leave us as soon as they get what they want. It's gotta be something we simple folks don't know about, but those up there do...<end>

segment.source: Them bloody Oligarchs! They must've messed things up again as always: Like, you got the Praetorians beating us, you got Drop Zone, the plague, the Protectorate noggins at the docks, the Free Drones graffiti popping up all over the city - they're gonna start fightin' on the streets with the Protectorate, I'm tellin' ya - and lotsa other stuff... and now this. It's all their bloody fault!<end>

segment.source: At least *we're* tucked in here. Right, youngster, eh?<end>

segment.source: Nice to meet you, Tom, I'm $(context.player.Name).<end>
